title: Free filtration of the total complex of two-step split columns
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $K^{p,q}$ a bicomplex of $A$-modules, with commuting differentials $d_h:K^{p,q}\to K^{p+1,q}$ and $d_v:K^{p,q}\to K^{p,q+1}$ (each squaring to zero), whose columns are cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Suppose every column $p>0$ is zero. For every $p\le0$ suppose there is a degreewise split short exact sequence of cochain complexes $0\to U_p\to B_p\to V_p\to0$, an isomorphism $B_p\cong K^{p,\bullet}$, and decompositions of $U_p$ and $V_p$ as direct sums of single-degree copies of $A$, indexed by sets in the universe of $A$. Let $T^n=\bigoplus_{p+q=n}K^{p,q}$ with differential $d_h+(-1)^p d_v$. Then there exist cochain complexes $F_n$ for $n\in\mathbf N$, monomorphisms $\iota_n:F_n\to T$, and maps $s_n:F_n\to F_{n+1}$, with $F_0=0$, $s_n\iota_{n+1}=\iota_n$, every element of every $T^k$ in the image of some $\iota_n^k$, every $s_n^k$ admitting a retraction, and every cokernel $\operatorname{coker}(s_n)$ isomorphic as a complex to a direct sum of single-degree copies of $A$ indexed in its universe. No exactness of the horizontal rows, augmentation, or quasi-isomorphism is assumed.

proof.text: Construct explicit alternating column submodules and restricted complexes; obtain stage zero, monomorphic inclusions and compatibility from their concrete helpers.
Use the finite-support exhaustiveness lemma for total-degree elements.
Use the split-free quotient lemma for degreewise retractions and coproduct cokernel descriptions.

lean.statement: theorem exists_totalFreeFiltration {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (K : HomologicalComplex₂ (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) (h_positive : ∀ p : ℤ, 0 < p → IsZero (K.X p)) (h_columns : ∀ p : ℤ, p ≤ 0 → ∃ S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ), Nonempty (S.X₂ ≅ K.X p) ∧ S.ShortExact ∧ (∀ k : ℤ, Nonempty (S.map (HomologicalComplex.eval (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) k)).Splitting) ∧ ∃ (I₁ I₃ : Type u) (d₁ : I₁ → ℤ) (d₃ : I₃ → ℤ), Nonempty (S.X₁ ≅ ∐ (fun i : I₁ ↦ (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (d₁ i)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))) ∧ Nonempty (S.X₃ ≅ ∐ (fun i : I₃ ↦ (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (d₃ i)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A)))) : ∃ (F : ℕ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (ι : ∀ n, F n ⟶ K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) (step : ∀ n, F n ⟶ F (n + 1)), IsZero (F 0) ∧ (∀ n, Mono (ι n)) ∧ (∀ n, step n ≫ ι (n + 1) = ι n) ∧ (∀ (k : ℤ) (x : (K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).X k), ∃ (n : ℕ) (y : (F n).X k), (ι n).f k y = x) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ), ∃ r : (F (n + 1)).X k ⟶ (F n).X k, (step n).f k ≫ r = 𝟙 ((F n).X k)) ∧ (∀ n, ∃ (I : Type u) (degree : I → ℤ), Nonempty (cokernel (step n) ≅ ∐ (fun i : I ↦ (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (degree i)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))))
